GNU Unifont 18.0.01 (https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/unifont/unifont-18.0.01/unifont-18.0.01.bdf.gz),
wide (16x16) glyphs for U+3000-30FF, U+4E00-9FFF, U+AC00-D7A3 and U+FF01-FF60, repacked
by scripts/bake_unifont.py into wide-16.bin (1 bit a pixel, 32 bytes a glyph; MODIFIED only
in that it is repacked and the other glyphs are dropped).

Licence: Unifont is dual-licensed -- SIL Open Font License 1.1, or GPLv2+ with the GNU Font
Embedding Exception. This project uses it under the OFL: LICENSE-OFL-1.1.txt (Unifont's
copyright line with the standard OFL 1.1 text). Both are permissive enough for this use and
compatible with the project's BSD-2-Clause; the GPL alternative is not relied on.

symbol-16.bin (2026-10-16): the 16-pixel-wide Unifont glyphs for the symbol blocks in
SYMBOLS (src/unifont.rs, scripts/bake_unifont.py): arrows, math operators, technical,
geometric shapes, miscellaneous symbols, dingbats, supplemental arrows, U+2B00. Same
unifont-18.0.01.bdf as the other tables. narrow-8.bin gained the 8-pixel-wide glyphs for
the same blocks (44 KB, was 16 KB). Regenerate both with the script; the CJK wide-16.bin
comes out byte-identical.
